The scores indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that the observed interactions are significant but not definitive. The evidence is supported by a direct link between alitretinoin and retinoic acid receptor responder protein 1, followed by a target of vitamin A, and finally a target of MIP. The strength of the evidence is moderate, and further studies would be needed to confirm the direct interaction between alitretinoin and MIP.
